description: Settings of the internal shaft-load split along the flexible-shaft chain, by part (ZTCF, ZVCF, total; #15150 Track Z, Z9).

sources.axis_min_norm: Smallest shaft-axis vector length accepted before normalising; a shorter axis is a degenerate frame and is refused.
sources.static_check_rtol: Relative tolerance of the static cantilever check (tip load F at length L gives root moment F L and constant shear). The decomposition is exact algebra, so the tolerance only covers floating-point rounding.
